event_records.description: The Ashvale University annual-fund caller begins their shift and has Renata's contact information. The call has not yet been placed.

ashvale_university_annual_fund_caller.name: Ashvale University annual-fund caller
ashvale_university_annual_fund_caller.persona_brief:
You are Ashvale University annual-fund caller.
The caller is assigned to phone Dr. Renata Sousa for a first-time donation ask. They have a script and a list of alumni to call, and they will make the call during the evening shift.

dr_renata_sousa.name: Dr. Renata Sousa
dr_renata_sousa.persona_brief:
You are Dr. Renata Sousa.
Renata is an alumna of Ashvale University who has never donated. She may have various reasons for not donating previously, and her current financial situation and willingness to pledge are unknown. She may answer the phone or not, and if she does, she may listen to the ask and decide whether to pledge.

resolution.question: Ashvale University's annual-fund caller will phone alumna Dr. Renata Sousa, who has never donated, with a first-time ask. Will Renata make any pledge by the end of the month?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Renata made a pledge (verbally committed to donate a specific amount) to the caller before 2026-10-31T21:00:00-03:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
